highlight.name: Green
highlight.use: Sparingly, for a focal point: one small element that should catch the eye.

scenes.headline: A Millimetre at a Time
scenes.angle: very high looking down, near top-down view of a street
scenes.highlightElement: a small survey marker disc set in the pavement
scenes.prompt: Follows the attached style guide image (style only, not its subjects). Contemporary editorial illustration in clean fine black ink line, slightly worn with small pen-lift breaks, and flat colour with one cel-shadow tone per surface, risograph print feel, paper grain. Very high angle looking almost straight down on a Lagos street edge at midday: a pavement with a long hairline crack and one sagging slab, tilted tiles, thin-line hatching on cracks and kerb. A Nigerian woman surveyor in a wrapped headtie and work vest, seen from behind and small, kneels with a measuring staff; beside her a young Black man in a hard hat in profile, face drawn with a few lines. Five fingers, natural knuckles, full-length thumbs. Hard-edged shadow shapes. Palette only: hot pink #F33496, pale pink #FFD9E6, grey-mauve #7C6D72, deep plum #370E21, black and white, with tints and shades. The top 25% of the image is plain flat pale pink with no detail, for the headline. The survey marker disc is solid green (#4BF761), the only green thing in the whole image; it is the focal point. No text, letters, logos or signatures.

scenes.headline: The Ground Gives Way Slowly
scenes.angle: very low worm's-eye looking up at a tilted apartment tower
scenes.highlightElement: a single lit window in the tower
scenes.prompt: Follows the attached style guide image (style only, not its subjects). Contemporary editorial illustration in clean fine black ink line with small breaks, flat colour, one cel-shadow tone per surface, stepped-band sky, risograph feel, paper grain. Very low worm's-eye angle looking up at a row of Alexandria seafront apartment blocks with balconies and shuttered windows, slightly leaning in strong perspective, the lower walls stained by a damp tide line drawn with thin hatching, water pooled in the street at the base reflecting with ripple lines. A small elderly Egyptian man in a galabeya and white skullcap, seen in profile and tiny, wades along the edge carrying a bag; his face a few simple lines, grey moustache. Five fingers, natural hands. Palette only: hot pink #F33496, pale pink #FFD9E6, grey-mauve #7C6D72, deep plum #370E21, black, white, with tints and shades. The top 25% is a plain flat stepped pink sky, no detail, for the headline. The lit window is solid green (#4BF761), the only green thing in the whole image; it is the focal point. No text, letters, logos or signatures.

scenes.headline: Seen From Orbit, Cities Settle
scenes.angle: lone object in a big sky, satellite small above a curved horizon
scenes.prompt: Follows the attached style guide image (style only, not its subjects). Contemporary editorial illustration in clean fine black ink line, flat colour, one cel-shadow tone, stepped-band glows, risograph print feel, paper grain. A lone small satellite with solar panels floats in a vast deep plum #370E21 sky above the curved edge of the Earth, which is drawn in the lower middle as flat grey-mauve and pink bands with a tiny grid of a coastal African city delta, thin-line hatched coastline and a fine scan beam of pale pink lines dropping from the satellite toward the city. Big simple space against small precise detail, fish-eye slight curvature. No people. Palette only: hot pink #F33496, pale pink #FFD9E6, grey-mauve #7C6D72, deep plum #370E21, black, white, with tints and shades. The top 20% and bottom 20% of the image are plain flat deep plum with no detail, for the headline. The satellite is solid green (#4BF761), the only green thing in the whole image; it is the focal point. No text, letters, logos or signatures.

scenes.angle: cutaway cross-section showing street above and ground layers below
scenes.highlightElement: a small green measuring pin driven into the ground
